improvements: P2 75 -> 38 and P6 16 -> 0: 26 calls named (isTokenEnabled, balanceOf, whitelistedUsers, safeModule.unknown880841fe with its bytes argument decoded as Array(len=68, data=Bytes(4, 0xa9059cbb), caller, ...)), 16 reverts and 8 event payloads decoded (raw reverts 53 -> 33). In the four safeModule loops the 'if x == token: ... else: revert' nests became early reverts (0x7ac7f97c, 0x73bf9e5f). Loops over the copied token array read 'while s < mem[128]' without the redundant Panic(50) test. One P7 copy loop is gone (while 69 -> 65), copy lengths fold (while v < 100, args mem[_334 + 132 len 100]), and two memory-read tests now use variables (if not _14). 4308 -> 4092 lines.
notes: Diff 2929 lines, 12 changed functions, reviewed by skeleton comparison (control flow, calls, writes, events, reverts) plus the changed regions read in full: unknown191eb90e, the safeModule loop of unknown0473d2bb (renames idx->s, s->t consistent), the zero-divisor parts of unknown05414b41, the transferFrom copy of unknowncf4f4dc6. 'call X.mem[mem[64] len 4]' displays 17 -> 24: calls that were fully raw (static call stor409 with: args mem[..]) now show the selector as a memory slice, neutral. As in c00079, the masked selector store adds a redundant 'mem[p + 36 len 28] = caller >> 32' line (2 sites, 2528 and its twin). The 0x23d359a3 revert and the stor409 calls were raw before too.
summary: Clearly better overall (P2 halved, 16 reverts decoded, loops tidier, one copy loop gone), with two low regressions in unknown05414b41: four 0xee89a6dc reverts and one call's bytes tail fell back to raw memory, and four redundant Panic(18) tests appeared.
